scope: Race-phase controller gains only, layered on the verified preview20_xy configuration. Prehover gains, release thresholds, simulator inertia, force model, gates, clocks and the race judge are unchanged. Profiles are hypotheses until an actual 12-gate flight passes every check.
observed_motivation: Three independent 1.26 preview20_xy flights (3.2555, 3.2604, 3.2508 s) show repeatable gate offsets up to 0.68 m with a 36/12 position loop (natural frequency 6 rad/s). A stiffer, still critically damped, position loop and a faster attitude loop are the remaining in-bounds controller levers.

xy20_pos50.hypothesis: Position loop 50/14 (natural frequency 7.07 rad/s, damping ratio 0.99) reduces steady tracking lag without changing the attitude loop.

xy20_att75.hypothesis: Attitude loop 75/5 shortens the force-direction lag that the attitude analysis measured at 27.5 degrees mean; the unchanged 7 rad/s feedforward cap still bounds the nominal rate request.

xy20_pos50_att75.hypothesis: Both loops stiffer together; only selected if each single change is at least neutral in actual gate margins.

preview20_xy_sync.hypothesis: Identical control law and gains to preview20_xy; the rotor command is issued once per simulator step as soon as that step's reference has arrived (8 ms watchdog), instead of a free-running 1 kHz wall timer whose phase relative to the 50 Hz physics step is random. Aim: reduce run-to-run gate-offset spread.

modphys14_kr90.hypothesis: MODIFIED PHYSICS STUDY ONLY (requires --modified-physics 14): with the Unity angular speed cap raised to 14 rad/s the surrogate prefers a stiffer attitude loop kR=90 (komega unchanged; komega>4 is unstable at 50 Hz feedback). Not an official-physics configuration.

modphys14_kr60.hypothesis: MODIFIED PHYSICS STUDY ONLY: same gains as preview20_xy, feedforward rate cap raised to the modified 14 rad/s.
